firstPlayerRule: Choose the first player randomly and give them the First Player token. Play proceeds clockwise.
clarifications: During setup, Government cards are chosen in the opposite direction: begin with the last player, then continue counterclockwise. This does not change the clockwise play order.
On your first turn, place your Action pawn on a base Action space.
Each turn proceeds through Action, Expansion, Production and Objective phases, then passes to the next clockwise player.
